class: a red that was already on main read as the change's, or the base re-run on every run
caught_by: the base side is inherited from a cached pass of the same tier at the base tree (a fail is never inherited), run in a worktree at the base, or absent. Absent, it is not-run (unmeasured), and every red over it is newly red with basis no-base
missed_by: no base result at all, so a pre-existing red and a new one looked the same

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
